The overview puts four KPI tiles in a 2×2 grid on the left. Each tile shows a value, a label and an up/down trend. A bar chart on the right compares last quarter with this quarter for the same four metrics.

The catalog has no generic container, so I used a two-column layout as the root, with the tiles and chart as inline blocks inside it. Each block carries both `type` and `component` keys because I couldn't tell which one the renderer reads for inline blocks.
